name: io.github.robert-vetter/tessera
title: Tessera — the evidence layer for AI agents
description: Grounded answers with claim-level provenance over your data (CI runs, CSVs, documents); refuses when evidence is insufficient; drafts actions only from verifier-passing claims, previews the exact request, and executes behind approval with an auditable receipt (the public server's actuator is simulated: sent=false, no credential). Deterministic — no LLM in the trust path.
